headline: Global talks on autonomous AI weapons deferred to 2028
summary: Negotiators at international talks agreed to postpone decisions on regulating lethal autonomous weapons systems using artificial intelligence until 2028.
why: The UN Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons provides a platform for state discussions on autonomous military hardware.

impacts.name: United Nations
impacts.why: Deferring restrictions allows defense contractors continued development of AI military platforms.
